en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a stone bridge over a small river with rocky banks, modest houses beside the bridge, and a tall square medieval tower with crenellations in the background. A metal pedestrian or rail bridge appears on the left. The printed caption at the top right reads "Trento - Torre Vanga." The image has an aged, early‑20th‑century photographic style with a light border typical of old postcards.
